hero.subtitle: A house with character, ten minutes from Trikala

about.label: The House
about.heading: A house full of stories
about.text: A house with character in Raxa, ten minutes from Trikala. A stone fireplace, wooden ceilings, mosaic floors and antiques in every corner — plus a large fenced lawn where children and pets can run free.
about.text2: Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, up to six guests. And a family that welcomes you as one of their own — the thing our guests remember most.

0.title: Welcome
0.text: A pink house among the green — or in the snow, if you come in winter.

1.title: The living room
1.text: A chandelier, the stone fireplace and leather sofas.

2.title: The wooden staircase
2.text: Leading up to the loft and the upstairs bedrooms.

3.title: The bedrooms
3.text: Canopy beds, crisp white linen and real quiet.

4.title: Every room, a surprise
4.text: Antiques, colour and details you won’t find anywhere else.

5.title: The bathroom
5.text: A stained-glass skylight and mosaic tiles.

attractions.label: The Area
attractions.heading: In the heart of Thessaly

meteora.title: Meteora
meteora.desc: 14th-century monasteries atop 400m rock pillars. UNESCO World Heritage Site with breathtaking views.

elati.title: Elati
elati.desc: The largest mountain village. Hiking, forests, snow, and traditional architecture await.

pertouli.title: Pertouli
pertouli.desc: Mountain village with a ski resort. Lush green forests and a variety of activities.

palaiokarya.title: Palaiokarya Waterfalls
palaiokarya.desc: Impressive waterfalls and a stone bridge from 1517.

attractions.intro: Meteora, mountain villages and waterfalls — everything is within easy reach. Tap a place to see it on the map.

contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Ask us anything
contact.intro: Dates, pets, or anything else you want to know — message or call us. Konstantinos and his family will be happy to help.

footer.tagline: A house with character in Raxa, ten minutes from Trikala.

availability.label: Availability
availability.heading: Choose your dates
availability.intro: Pick your arrival and departure on the calendar and send us a message on WhatsApp — your dates are carried over automatically.
